'''Ryn''' was a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[3643 BBY|Near the end]] of the Cold War, Ryn worked on the Republic-aligned [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> On Ord Mantell, she worked in the [[Avilatan's Rest]] Cantina built within the [[Republic Army]]'s stronghold, [[Fort Garnik]]. Her job consisted of selling [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] tokens to allow customers to select music to be played. Ryn worked with at least one other Twi'lek behind the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] bar.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryn was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears in the cantina on Ord Mantell, a Republic-only planet. She serves as a Cantina Vendor, selling [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] tokens which allowed players to select one of five music tracks to be played in the cantina.<ref name="TOR" />
